correctness.rationale: For odd n>=5, 3 does not divide n, the independence complex of C_n and that of its connected Kronecker double cover C_2n each have rank-one integral sphere homology in dimensions d and e. Rotations act trivially by odd order. For reflections, alternating independent-set orbits give -I(P_(n-1)/2;-1) and -I(P_(n+1);-1), whose six-periodic recurrence yields the alpha_n and beta_n sign table. Complete layer folds are inclusions of D_n-invariant induced complexes, so they induce integral D_n-module isomorphisms even when a sequential pointwise fold order is not equivariant. In X=A union (w*B), reduced Mayer-Vietoris shifts B by one; the distinct-degree gap at l=3k and contractibility in other residue cases give displayed modules. Checked the n=5,7,11,13 table against recurrence; at l=1 n=5 reflection trace -1 agrees with published ordinary Mycielski theorem. Acyclicity of n=5 quotient at l=1,2 modulo 6 follows from the signs. No finite check substitutes for arbitrary depth proof.
